title: Vegan Dumpling Meal
description: A hearty, comforting vegan meal featuring pillowy dumplings in a savory sauce.
instructions: Combine flour and water to form dumpling dough.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a ball and flatten slightly.
Mix vegan meal with savory spices.
Place a tablespoon of filling in the center of each dumpling.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-circle.
Seal the edges with a fork.
Heat vegan oil in a pan over medium heat.
Cook dumplings for 5 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Serve hot with your favorite sauce.
